versions.description: Key-based loot crates. Admins define crates with a weighted reward table: currency, items or both, each with a rarity. Players get keys by buying them with currency ({prefix}crate buy), from a Takaro shop listing that uses the giveCrateKey shop action, or from an admin ({prefix}crate givekey). {prefix}crate open uses a key and rolls a reward; rare and better drops are announced to the server. {prefix}crates lists every crate, your keys and the odds.

commands.name: crate
commands.description: Buy, open or give crate keys.
commands.helpText: crate buy <name> [amount] | crate open <name> | crate givekey <player> <name> [amount] (admin)

commands.name: crates
commands.description: List crates, your keys and the odds.
commands.helpText: crates shows every crate and your keys. crates <name> shows the odds of one crate.

arguments.name: crate
arguments.helpText: Optional crate name to see its odds

functions.name: crate-helpers

permissions.description: Allows giving crate keys to players with crate givekey.
Discount in percent on crate keys bought with currency. The count is the percentage (for example 20 = 20% off). Good for VIP roles.

shopActions.name: giveCrateKey
shopActions.description: Gives crate keys to the buyer. The listing name must contain the crate name (for example "Gold crate key"); start it with a number and x for packs ("5x Gold crate key"). Keys given = pack size x amount ordered.
